    ∀ g, SignedSupport.wordSpectrum (e.word x) (e.outputLength n) (windowLength k) g = 0 ∨
      SignedSupport.wordSpectrum (e.word x) (e.outputLength n) (windowLength k) g = 1
proof:
:=
  SpectrumPath.spectrum_boolean (e.word x) (e.outputLength n) (windowLength k)
    (one_edit_unique hk x hx e he)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.mem_selectedBlocks
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_selectedBlocks {k : ℕ} (G I B : RuleSet k) :
    B ∈ selectedBlocks G I ↔ B ∈ blocks G ∧ (B ∩ I).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [selectedBlocks]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.subtype_connected
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel u v huv => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨u.property, v.property, huv⟩
  | refl u => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm u v huv ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans u v z huv hvz ihuv ihvz => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihuv ihvz

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.indexed_relation
statement:
private theorem indexed_relation {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ)) :
    RelationSupport.Relation (fun u : G => u.val) w
      (fun u : G => if u.val ∈ I then a u.val else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro g
  rw [hrel g]
  symm
  calc
    (∑ u : G, (if u.val ∈ I then a u.val else 0) * (u.val g : ℚ)) =
        ∑ u ∈ G, (if u ∈ I then a u else 0) * (u g : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_bij (fun (u : G) _ => u.val)
      · intro u _
        exact u.property
      · intro u _ v _ huv
        exact Subtype.ext huv
      · intro u hu
        exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
      · intro u _
        rfl
    _ = ∑ u ∈ I, (if u ∈ I then a u else 0) * (u g : ℚ) := by
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset hIG
      intro u _ hu
      simp [hu]
    _ = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro u hu
      simp only [if_pos hu]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.selected_block_nonzero
statement:
theorem selected_block_nonzero {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun (u : G) g => (u.val g : ℚ)))
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ))
    (B : RuleSet k) (hB : B ∈ selectedBlocks G I) :
    ∃ g u, u ∈ B ∧ u g ≠ 0 ∧ w g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hBblock, hBI⟩ := (mem_selectedBlocks G I B).mp hB
  let T : Finset G := Finset.univ.filter (fun u => u.val ∈ B)
  let coeff : G → ℚ := fun u => if u.val ∈ I then a u.val else 0
  have hmem (u : G) : u ∈ T ↔ u.val ∈ B := by
    simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have hactive : ∃ u ∈ T, coeff u ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hBI
    obtain ⟨huB, huI⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hu
    let uG : G := ⟨u, hIG huI⟩
    refine ⟨uG, (hmem uG).mpr huB, ?_⟩
    simpa only [coeff, uG, if_pos huI] using ha u huI
  have hclosed : GeneratingBlocks.BlockClosed (fun u : G => u.val) (↑T : Set G) := by
    intro u hu v huv
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := (mem_blocks G B).mp hBblock
    have huB : u.val ∈ blockOf G r := by rw [hr]; exact (hmem u).mp hu
    have hru := ((mem_blockOf G r u.val).mp huB).2
    apply (hmem v).mpr
    rw [← hr]
    exact (mem_blockOf G r v.val).mpr ⟨v.property,
      Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ hru (subtype_connected G huv)⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hw, u, hu, hug⟩ := RelationBlockSupport.block_restriction_nonzero
    (fun u : G => u.val) w coeff hind (indexed_relation G I hIG w a hrel)
    T hactive hclosed
  exact ⟨g, u.val, (hmem u).mp hu, hug, hw⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.selected_block_meets
statement:
theorem selected_block_meets {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun (u : G) g => (u.val g : ℚ)))
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ))
    (B : RuleSet k) (hB : B ∈ selectedBlocks G I) :
    ∃ v, Incident B v ∧ Incident {w} v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, u, hu, hug, hwg⟩ := selected_block_nonzero G I hIG w a hind ha hrel B hB
  exact ⟨gramPrefix g,
    (incident_iff_rule B (gramPrefix g)).mpr
      ⟨u, hu, GeneratingBlocks.nonzero_incident u g hug⟩,
    GeneratingBlocks.nonzero_incident w g hwg⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.selectedBlocks_subset_attachedBlocks
statement:
theorem selectedBlocks_subset_attachedBlocks {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun (u : G) g => (u.val g : ℚ)))
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ)) :
    selectedBlocks G I ⊆ attachedBlocks G w
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB
  exact (mem_attachedBlocks G B w).mpr
    ⟨((mem_selectedBlocks G I B).mp hB).1,
      selected_block_meets G I hIG w a hind ha hrel B hB⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.relation_support_included
statement:
theorem relation_support_included {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ)) :
    SupportInclusion.CoordinateSupportIncluded {w} G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzg⟩ := hg
  have hzw : z = w := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hz
  subst z
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  have hzero : (w g : ℚ) = 0 := by
    rw [hrel g]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro u hu
    simp [hnone u (hIG hu)]
  exact hzg (by exact_mod_cast hzero)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteRelationBlocks.selectedBlocks_biUnion
statement:
theorem selectedBlocks_biUnion {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G) :
    (selectedBlocks G I).biUnion id = RelationBlockSavings.blockHull G I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext u
  constructor
  · intro hu
    obtain ⟨B, hB, huB⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hu
    obtain ⟨hBblock, i, hi⟩ := (mem_selectedBlocks G I B).mp hB
    obtain ⟨hiB, hiI⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := (mem_blocks G B).mp hBblock
    have hui := (mem_blockOf G r u).mp (by simpa only [hr, id_eq] using huB)
    have hii := (mem_blockOf G r i).mp (by simpa only [hr] using hiB)
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨hui.1, i, hiI, Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _
      (Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ hii.2) hui.2⟩
  · intro hu
    obtain ⟨_, i, hiI, hiu⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hu
    have hiG := hIG hiI
    have hiB : i ∈ blockOf G i :=
      (mem_blockOf G i i).mpr ⟨hiG, Relation.EqvGen.refl i⟩
    have hB : blockOf G i ∈ selectedBlocks G I :=
      (mem_selectedBlocks G I (blockOf G i)).mpr
        ⟨(mem_blocks G (blockOf G i)).mpr ⟨i, hiG, rfl⟩,
          i, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hiB, hiI⟩⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨blockOf G i, hB,
      (mem_blockOf G i u).mpr ⟨(RelationBlockSavings.blockHull_subset G I hu), hiu⟩⟩

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionBound.candidate_count_le
statement:
theorem candidate_count_le (t : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (x : Letters) (n k R : ℕ)
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hx : KUnique x n k) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hbonus : windowLength k < R → n ≤ 2 ^ R)
    (hL : 4 * t + 2 ≤ windowLength k) (hcut : R ≤ cutoff t k) :
    Nat.card {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t x n k R U} ≤ (scale t n k) ^ R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 ^ R * (2 * t * R + 1) * n ^ ((2 * t - 1) * R) *
        (windowLength k * R) ^ (CountExponent.exponent t * R) :=
      candidate_card_bound t ht x n k R hR hx hn hbonus
    _ = n ^ ((2 * t - 1) * R) *
        (2 ^ R * (2 * t * R + 1) * (windowLength k * R) ^ (CountExponent.exponent t * R)) := by ring
    _ ≤ n ^ ((2 * t - 1) * R) * (windowLength k) ^ (WitnessCost.exponent t * R) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (WitnessCost.cost_le t (windowLength k) R hL hcut)
    _ = _ := by simp only [scale, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionBound.survival_term_le
statement:
theorem survival_term_le (C N Q R : ℕ) (hC : C ≤ N ^ R) (hQ : 8 * N ≤ Q)
    (hQpos : 0 < Q) :
    (C : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ R)
proof:
:= by
  have hQr : (0 : ℝ) < Q := by exact_mod_cast hQpos
  have hNQ : 8 * (N : ℝ) ≤ Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hratio : (N : ℝ) * (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hQr]
    linarith
  have hcast : (C : ENNReal) ≤ (N : ENNReal) ^ R := by exact_mod_cast hC
  calc
    _ ≤ (N : ENNReal) ^ R * ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast (by positivity)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((N : ℝ) * (2 / (Q : ℝ))) ^ R := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg N), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, mul_pow]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ R := pow_le_pow_left' (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hratio) R
    _ = _ := (ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity) R).symm

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionBound.geometric_tail_identity
statement:
theorem geometric_tail_identity (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (i + 2)) = (1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ N) / 12
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    simp only [pow_succ]
    ring

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionBound.geometric_tail_le
statement:
theorem geometric_tail_le (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ R) ≤ 1 / 12
proof:
:= by
  have hset : Finset.Icc 2 M = Finset.Ico 2 (M + 1) := by ext i; simp
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
  simp_rw [Nat.add_comm 2]
  rw [geometric_tail_identity]
  have hpos : 0 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (M + 1 - 2) := by positivity
  linarith

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionBound.obstruction_measure_le
statement:
theorem obstruction_measure_le {n : ℕ} (t k Q : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (x : Bits n)
    (hx : KUnique (padBits x) n k) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hL : 4 * t + 2 ≤ windowLength k)
    (hbonus : ∀ R, windowLength k < R → n ≤ 2 ^ R)
    (hQ : 8 * scale t n k ≤ Q) (hQtwo : 2 ≤ Q) :
    realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (obstructionEvent t k Q x) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 12 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k),
        (Nat.card {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U} : ENNReal) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R := obstruction_probability_le t k Q ht hQtwo x
    _ ≤ ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k), ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ R) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro R hR
      exact survival_term_le _ _ Q R
        (candidate_count_le t ht (padBits x) n k R (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hR).1 hx hn
          (hbonus R) hL (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hR).2) hQ (by omega)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k), (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ R) :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (geometric_tail_le _)

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.column_isEdit
statement:
theorem column_isEdit (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    (column trace c).isEdit = true
proof: := c.property

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.column_cases
statement:
theorem column_cases (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    (∃ bit, column trace c = .deletion bit) ∨ (∃ bit, column trace c = .insertion bit)
proof:
:= by
  have h := column_isEdit trace c
  cases hc : column trace c with
  | matched bit => simp only [hc, Column.isEdit, Bool.false_eq_true] at h
  | deletion bit => exact Or.inl ⟨bit, rfl⟩
  | insertion bit => exact Or.inr ⟨bit, rfl⟩

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.orientation_of_deletion
statement:
theorem orientation_of_deletion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) : orientation trace c = .deletion
proof:
:= by
  simp [orientation, hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.orientation_of_insertion
statement:
theorem orientation_of_insertion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) : orientation trace c = .insertion
proof:
:= by
  simp [orientation, hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.bit_of_deletion
statement:
theorem bit_of_deletion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) : bit trace c = b
proof: := by simp [bit, hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.bit_of_insertion
statement:
theorem bit_of_insertion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) : bit trace c = b
proof: := by simp [bit, hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.oneEditTarget_of_deletion
statement:
theorem oneEditTarget_of_deletion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) :
    oneEditTarget trace c = trace.source.eraseIdx (position trace c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [oneEditTarget, orientation_of_deletion trace c b hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.oneEditTarget_of_insertion
statement:
theorem oneEditTarget_of_insertion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) :
    oneEditTarget trace c = trace.source.take (position trace c) ++
      b :: trace.source.drop (position trace c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [oneEditTarget, orientation_of_insertion trace c b hc, bit_of_insertion trace c b hc]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.isDeletion_edit
statement: private theorem isDeletion_edit (col : Column) (h : isDeletion col = true) : col.isEdit = true
proof:
:= by
  cases col <;> simp_all only [isDeletion, Column.isEdit, Bool.false_eq_true]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.isInsertion_edit
statement: private theorem isInsertion_edit (col : Column) (h : isInsertion col = true) : col.isEdit = true
proof:
:= by
  cases col <;> simp_all only [isInsertion, Column.isEdit, Bool.false_eq_true]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.orientation_eq_deletion_iff
statement:
theorem orientation_eq_deletion_iff (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    orientation trace c = .deletion ↔ isDeletion (column trace c) = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases column_cases trace c with ⟨b, hc⟩ | ⟨b, hc⟩
  · simp only [orientation_of_deletion trace c b hc, hc, isDeletion]
  · simp only [orientation_of_insertion trace c b hc, hc, isDeletion, reduceCtorEq,
      Bool.false_eq_true]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.orientation_eq_insertion_iff
statement:
theorem orientation_eq_insertion_iff (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    orientation trace c = .insertion ↔ isInsertion (column trace c) = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases column_cases trace c with ⟨b, hc⟩ | ⟨b, hc⟩
  · simp only [orientation_of_deletion trace c b hc, hc, isInsertion, reduceCtorEq,
      Bool.false_eq_true]
  · simp only [orientation_of_insertion trace c b hc, hc, isInsertion]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.card_column_predicate
statement:
theorem card_column_predicate (trace : Trace) (p : Column → Bool) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin trace.length // p (trace.get i) = true} = trace.countP p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
  induction trace with
  | nil => simp
  | cons col rest ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.sum_univ_succ, List.get_cons_zero,
      List.get_cons_succ', List.countP_cons, ih]
    by_cases hp : p col = true <;> simp_all [Nat.add_comm]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.countP_isDeletion
statement: theorem countP_isDeletion (trace : Trace) : trace.countP isDeletion = trace.deletions
proof:
:= by
  induction trace with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons col rest ih =>
    cases col <;> simp [isDeletion, List.countP_cons, Trace.deletions, ih]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.countP_isInsertion
statement: theorem countP_isInsertion (trace : Trace) : trace.countP isInsertion = trace.insertions
proof:
:= by
  induction trace with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons col rest ih =>
    cases col <;> simp [isInsertion, List.countP_cons, Trace.insertions, ih]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.countP_isEdit
statement:
theorem countP_isEdit (trace : Trace) :
    trace.countP Column.isEdit = trace.deletions + trace.insertions
proof:
:= by
  induction trace with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons col rest ih =>
    cases col <;>
      simp only [List.countP_cons, Column.isEdit, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ite_true, ite_false, Trace.deletions, Trace.insertions, ih] <;> omega

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.card_editColumn
statement:
theorem card_editColumn (trace : Trace) :
    Fintype.card (EditColumn trace) = trace.deletions + trace.insertions
proof:
:=
  (card_column_predicate trace Column.isEdit).trans (countP_isEdit trace)

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.card_deletionColumns
statement:
theorem card_deletionColumns (trace : Trace) :
    Fintype.card {c : EditColumn trace // orientation trace c = .deletion} = trace.deletions
proof:
:=
  (Fintype.card_congr (deletionColumnEquiv trace)).trans
    ((card_column_predicate trace isDeletion).trans (countP_isDeletion trace))

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.card_insertionColumns
statement:
theorem card_insertionColumns (trace : Trace) :
    Fintype.card {c : EditColumn trace // orientation trace c = .insertion} = trace.insertions
proof:
:=
  (Fintype.card_congr (insertionColumnEquiv trace)).trans
    ((card_column_predicate trace isInsertion).trans (countP_isInsertion trace))

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.position_eq_sourcePrefix_length
statement:
theorem position_eq_sourcePrefix_length (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    position trace c = (sourcePrefix trace c).length
proof: := rfl

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.split_column
statement:
theorem split_column (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    trace = trace.take c.val.val ++ column trace c :: trace.drop (c.val.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : trace.drop c.val.val = column trace c :: trace.drop (c.val.val + 1) :=
    List.drop_eq_getElem_cons c.val.isLt
  calc
    trace = trace.take c.val.val ++ trace.drop c.val.val :=
      (List.take_append_drop c.val.val trace).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [hd]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.source_split
statement:
theorem source_split (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    trace.source = sourcePrefix trace c ++
      Trace.source [column trace c] ++ sourceSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    trace.source = Trace.source
        (trace.take c.val.val ++ column trace c :: trace.drop (c.val.val + 1)) :=
      congrArg Trace.source (split_column trace c)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Trace.source_append]
      cases hc : column trace c <;> simp [sourcePrefix, sourceSuffix, Trace.source]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.target_split
statement:
theorem target_split (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    trace.target = targetPrefix trace c ++
      Trace.target [column trace c] ++ targetSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    trace.target = Trace.target
        (trace.take c.val.val ++ column trace c :: trace.drop (c.val.val + 1)) :=
      congrArg Trace.target (split_column trace c)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Trace.target_append]
      cases hc : column trace c <;> simp [targetPrefix, targetSuffix, Trace.target]

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.source_split_of_deletion
statement:
theorem source_split_of_deletion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) :
    trace.source = sourcePrefix trace c ++ b :: sourceSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hc, Trace.source, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using source_split trace c

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.source_split_of_insertion
statement:
theorem source_split_of_insertion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) :
    trace.source = sourcePrefix trace c ++ sourceSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hc, Trace.source, List.append_nil] using source_split trace c

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.target_split_of_deletion
statement:
theorem target_split_of_deletion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) :
    trace.target = targetPrefix trace c ++ targetSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hc, Trace.target, List.append_nil] using target_split trace c

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.target_split_of_insertion
statement:
theorem target_split_of_insertion (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) :
    trace.target = targetPrefix trace c ++ b :: targetSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hc, Trace.target, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using target_split trace c

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.oneEditTarget_deletion_split
statement:
theorem oneEditTarget_deletion_split (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) :
    oneEditTarget trace c = sourcePrefix trace c ++ sourceSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneEditTarget_of_deletion trace c b hc, position_eq_sourcePrefix_length,
    source_split_of_deletion trace c b hc]
  rw [List.eraseIdx_append_of_length_le (Nat.le_refl _)]
  simp

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.oneEditTarget_insertion_split
statement:
theorem oneEditTarget_insertion_split (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) :
    oneEditTarget trace c = sourcePrefix trace c ++ b :: sourceSuffix trace c
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneEditTarget_of_insertion trace c b hc, position_eq_sourcePrefix_length,
    source_split_of_insertion trace c b hc]
  simp

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.deletion_position_lt
statement:
theorem deletion_position_lt (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .deletion b) : position trace c < trace.source.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg List.length (source_split_of_deletion trace c b hc)
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at h
  rw [position_eq_sourcePrefix_length]
  omega

name: DeletionCode.TraceEditData.insertion_position_le
statement:
theorem insertion_position_le (trace : Trace) (c : EditColumn trace) (b : Bool)
    (hc : column trace c = .insertion b) : position trace c ≤ trace.source.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg List.length (source_split_of_insertion trace c b hc)
  simp only [List.length_append] at h
  rw [position_eq_sourcePrefix_length]
  omega

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.rational_step
statement:
@[simp] theorem rational_step
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (i : Fin m) :
    rational (step p i) = walkStep (rationalPath p) i
proof:
:= by
  funext g
  simp [rational, step, walkStep, rationalPath]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.mem_selectedRules
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_selectedRules
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (u : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) :
    u ∈ selectedRules p S ↔ ∃ i ∈ S, step p i = u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_image

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.step_mem_selectedRules
statement:
theorem step_mem_selectedRules
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i ∈ S) : step p i ∈ selectedRules p S
proof:
:=
  (mem_selectedRules p S _).mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedRules_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectedRules_empty
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) :
    selectedRules p ∅ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [selectedRules]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedRules_insert
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectedRules_insert
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (i : Fin m) : selectedRules p (insert i S) = insert (step p i) (selectedRules p S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [selectedRules]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selected_step_injOn
statement:
theorem selected_step_injOn
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m))) :
    Set.InjOn (step p) (↑S : Set (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj hij
  have heq : walkStep (rationalPath p) i = walkStep (rationalPath p) j := by
    simpa only [rational_step] using congrArg rational hij
  have hs : (⟨i, hi⟩ : S) = ⟨j, hj⟩ := hind.injective heq
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hs

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedIndex_exists
statement:
private theorem selectedIndex_exists
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (u : selectedRules p S) : ∃ i : S, step p i.val = u.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S u.val).mp u.property
  exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, heq⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedIndex_spec
statement:
theorem selectedIndex_spec
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (u : selectedRules p S) : step p (selectedIndex p S u).val = u.val
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (selectedIndex_exists p S u)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedIndex_injective
statement:
theorem selectedIndex_injective
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    Function.Injective (selectedIndex p S)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    u.val = step p (selectedIndex p S u).val := (selectedIndex_spec p S u).symm
    _ = step p (selectedIndex p S v).val := by rw [huv]
    _ = v.val := selectedIndex_spec p S v

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedIndex_step
statement:
theorem selectedIndex_step
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m)))
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i ∈ S) :
    (selectedIndex p S ⟨step p i, step_mem_selectedRules p S i hi⟩).val = i
proof:
:=
  selected_step_injOn p S hind (selectedIndex p S _).property hi
    (selectedIndex_spec p S _)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selected_independent
statement:
theorem selected_independent
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m))) :
    Independent (selectedRules p S)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hind.comp (selectedIndex p S) (selectedIndex_injective p S)
  change LinearIndependent ℚ (fun u : selectedRules p S => rational u.val)
  convert h using 1
  funext u
  change rational u.val = walkStep (rationalPath p) (selectedIndex p S u).val
  rw [← rational_step, selectedIndex_spec]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedRank_step
statement:
theorem selectedRank_step
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m)))
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i ∈ S) : selectedRank p S (step p i) = i.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [selectedRank, dif_pos (step_mem_selectedRules p S i hi)]
  rw [selectedIndex_step p S hind i hi]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedRank_injOn
statement:
theorem selectedRank_injOn
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m))) :
    Set.InjOn (selectedRank p S) (↑(selectedRules p S) : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv heq
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S u).mp hu
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S v).mp hv
  rw [selectedRank_step p S hind i hi, selectedRank_step p S hind j hj] at heq
  exact congrArg (step p) (Fin.ext heq)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selected_generatingAt
statement:
theorem selected_generatingAt
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hind : LinearIndepOn ℚ (walkStep (rationalPath p)) (↑S : Set (Fin m)))
    (hgen : GeneratingSelected (rationalPath p) S) :
    GeneratingAt (p 0) (selectedRules p S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨selected_independent p S hind, selectedRank p S,
    selectedRank_injOn p S hind, ?_⟩
  intro u hu g hneg
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S u).mp hu
  have hnegQ : walkStep (rationalPath p) i g = -1 := by
    rw [← rational_step]
    change (step p i g : ℚ) = -1
    exact_mod_cast hneg
  rcases hgen i hi g hnegQ with hbase | ⟨r, hr, hri, hrg⟩
  · left
    intro hz
    apply hbase
    simp [rationalPath, rational, hz]
  · right
    refine ⟨step p r, step_mem_selectedRules p S r hr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [selectedRank_step p S hind r hr,
        selectedRank_step p S hind i hi] using hri
    · intro hz
      apply hrg
      rw [← rational_step]
      simp [rational, hz]

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.rational_image_selectedRules
statement:
theorem rational_image_selectedRules
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    rational '' (↑(selectedRules p S) : Set _) =
      walkStep (rationalPath p) '' (↑S : Set (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S u).mp hu
    exact ⟨i, hi, (rational_step p i).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨step p i, step_mem_selectedRules p S i hi, rational_step p i⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.selectedSpan_eq
statement:
theorem selectedSpan_eq
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    selectedSpan (walkStep (rationalPath p)) S =
      Submodule.span ℚ (rational '' (↑(selectedRules p S) : Set _))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rational_image_selectedRules]
  rfl

name: DeletionCode.FiniteWalkRules.novelty_transfer
statement:
theorem novelty_transfer
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (i : Fin m)
    (hnew : ¬ SignedMember (walkStep (rationalPath p)) S (walkStep (rationalPath p) i)) :
    ∀ u ∈ selectedRules p S, step p i ≠ u ∧ step p i ≠ -u
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := (mem_selectedRules p S u).mp hu
  constructor
  · intro heq
    apply hnew
    refine ⟨r, hr, Or.inl ?_⟩
    simpa only [rational_step] using congrArg rational heq
  · intro heq
    apply hnew
    refine ⟨r, hr, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simpa only [rational_neg, rational_step] using congrArg rational heq

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.measurePreserving
statement:
theorem measurePreserving
    (f : (I → UnitAddCircle) →+ (J → UnitAddCircle))
    (hcont : Continuous f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :
    MeasurePreserving f volume volume
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.measurePreserving hcont hsurj (by simp)

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.coordinate_measurePreserving_of_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem coordinate_measurePreserving_of_measurePreserving
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → (J → UnitAddCircle)} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ volume) (j : J) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x => f x j) μ volume
proof:
:=
  (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : J => (volume : Measure UnitAddCircle)) j).comp hf

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.coordinates_independent_of_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem coordinates_independent_of_measurePreserving
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → (J → UnitAddCircle)} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ volume) :
    iIndepFun (fun j x => f x j) μ
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map f) := by
    rw [hf.map_eq]
    infer_instance
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_of_map hf.aemeasurable
  apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map
    (fun j => (coordinate_measurePreserving_of_measurePreserving hf j).aemeasurable)).2
  have hcoords (j : J) : μ.map (fun x => f x j) = volume :=
    (coordinate_measurePreserving_of_measurePreserving hf j).map_eq
  simp_rw [hcoords]
  exact hf.map_eq

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.coordinate_measurePreserving
statement:
theorem coordinate_measurePreserving
    (f : (I → UnitAddCircle) →+ (J → UnitAddCircle))
    (hcont : Continuous f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) (j : J) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x => f x j) volume volume
proof:
:=
  coordinate_measurePreserving_of_measurePreserving (measurePreserving f hcont hsurj) j

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.coordinates_independent
statement:
theorem coordinates_independent
    (f : (I → UnitAddCircle) →+ (J → UnitAddCircle))
    (hcont : Continuous f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :
    iIndepFun (fun j x => f x j) volume
proof:
:=
  coordinates_independent_of_measurePreserving (measurePreserving f hcont hsurj)

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.evaluations_independent
statement:
theorem evaluations_independent :
    iIndepFun (fun i (x : I → UnitAddCircle) => x i) volume
proof:
:= by
  exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => measurable_id.aemeasurable)

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.preimage_rectangle
statement:
theorem preimage_rectangle
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → (J → UnitAddCircle)} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ volume)
    (A : J → Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) :
    μ (f ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi A) = ∏ j, volume (A j)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ (f ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi A) = volume (Set.univ.pi A) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun ν : Measure (J → UnitAddCircle) => ν (Set.univ.pi A)) hf.map_eq
      rw [Measure.map_apply hf.measurable (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hA)] at h
      exact h
    _ = ∏ j, volume (A j) := volume_pi_pi A

name: DeletionCode.TorusHaar.forall_mem_measure
statement:
theorem forall_mem_measure
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {f : Ω → (J → UnitAddCircle)} (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ volume)
    (A : J → Set UnitAddCircle) (hA : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) :
    μ {x | ∀ j, f x j ∈ A j} = ∏ j, volume (A j)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {x | ∀ j, f x j ∈ A j} = f ⁻¹' Set.univ.pi A := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact preimage_rectangle hf A hA

name: DeletionCode.CountingLemma.generatingSet_mem
statement:
theorem generatingSet_mem (x : Letters) (n k ν R c : ℕ) (group : Fin ν → Fin R)
    (Q : RuleSet k) (hQ : GeneratingSet x n k ν R c group Q) :
    GeneratingRuleSet x n k ν R c group Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcard, hc, E, hrank, H, hdis, hgen, hrules⟩ := hQ
  have hcomponents := componentCount_rulesOfFamily E group hrank H hdis
  have hcomponentCount : Fintype.card (SupportComponents.GraphComponents E.family (windowLength k)) = c := by
    rw [← hcomponents, hrules]
    exact hc
  exact ⟨E, hrank, H, hdis, hgen, hcomponentCount, hrules⟩

name: DeletionCode.CountingLemma.generatingSet_finite
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingRuleSet x n k ν R c group Q} :=
    generatingRuleSet_finite x n k ν R c group hν hx
  exact Finite.of_injective (generatingSetInclusion x n k ν R c group)
    (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun Q : {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingRuleSet x n k ν R c group Q} => Q.val) h))

name: DeletionCode.CountingLemma.generatingSet_record_bound
statement:
theorem generatingSet_record_bound (x : Letters) (n k ν R c : ℕ)
    (group : Fin ν → Fin R) (hν : 1 ≤ ν) (hx : KUnique x n k) :
    Nat.card {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingSet x n k ν R c group Q} ≤
      n ^ c * fieldBound (windowLength k) ν ^ (50 * ν)
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingRuleSet x n k ν R c group Q} :=
    generatingRuleSet_finite x n k ν R c group hν hx
  have hcard := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (generatingSetInclusion x n k ν R c group)
    (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun Q : {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingRuleSet x n k ν R c group Q} => Q.val) h))
  exact hcard.trans (generatingRuleSet_card_bound x n k ν R c group hν hx)

name: DeletionCode.CountingLemma.counting_generating_sets
statement:
theorem counting_generating_sets (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (x : Letters)
    (n k R c : ℕ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hx : KUnique x n k)
    (group : Fin (2 * t * R) → Fin R) :
    Nat.card {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingSet x n k (2 * t * R) R c group Q} ≤
      n ^ c * (windowLength k * R) ^ (exponent t * R)
proof:
:= by
  have hν : 1 ≤ 2 * t * R := by nlinarith
  exact (generatingSet_record_bound x n k (2 * t * R) R c group hν hx).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n ^ c) (field_power_bound k t R hR))

name: DeletionCode.CountingLemma.exists_counting_exponent
statement:
theorem exists_counting_exponent (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 1 ≤ a ∧ ∀ (x : Letters) (n k R c : ℕ),
      1 ≤ R → KUnique x n k → ∀ group : Fin (2 * t * R) → Fin R,
        Nat.card {Q : RuleSet k // GeneratingSet x n k (2 * t * R) R c group Q} ≤
          n ^ c * (windowLength k * R) ^ (a * R)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨exponent t, exponent_pos t ht, fun x n k R c hR hx group =>
    counting_generating_sets t ht x n k R c hR hx group⟩

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.edge_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, g, hg, hu, hv⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzg⟩ := hsub g ⟨w, hw, hg⟩
  exact ⟨z, hz, g, hzg, hu, hv⟩

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.incident_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu | hu⟩ := hv
  · exact ⟨u, Or.inl (edge_mono hsub hu)⟩
  · exact ⟨u, Or.inr (edge_mono hsub hu)⟩

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.connected_mono
proof:
:= by
  induction hc with
  | rel a b hab => exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (edge_mono hsub hab)
  | refl a => exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm a b hab ih => exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ ih
  | trans a b c hab hbc ihab ihbc => exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ihab ihbc

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.supportComponentMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportComponentMap_mk {L : ℕ} {Q S : Finset (Gram L → ℤ)}
    (hsub : CoordinateSupportIncluded Q S) (v : RuleSetVertex Q) :
    supportComponentMap hsub (Quotient.mk (ruleSetSetoid Q) v) =
      Quotient.mk (ruleSetSetoid S) ⟨v.val, incident_mono hsub v.property⟩
proof: := rfl

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.hit_component_count_le_of_preimages
statement:
theorem hit_component_count_le_of_preimages {L : ℕ}
    {Q S : Finset (Gram L → ℤ)} (hsub : CoordinateSupportIncluded Q S)
    (P : RuleSetComponents S → Prop)
    (hhit : ∀ C, P C → ∃ D, supportComponentMap hsub D = C) :
    Fintype.card {C : RuleSetComponents S // P C} ≤ componentCount Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let select : {C : RuleSetComponents S // P C} → RuleSetComponents Q :=
    fun C => Classical.choose (hhit C.val C.property)
  have hselect : ∀ C, supportComponentMap hsub (select C) = C.val :=
    fun C => Classical.choose_spec (hhit C.val C.property)
  have hinj : Function.Injective select := by
    intro C D h
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      C.val = supportComponentMap hsub (select C) := (hselect C).symm
      _ = supportComponentMap hsub (select D) := congrArg (supportComponentMap hsub) h
      _ = D.val := hselect D
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective select hinj
  simpa only [componentCount, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard

name: DeletionCode.SupportInclusion.hit_component_count_le
statement:
theorem hit_component_count_le {L : ℕ} {Q S : Finset (Gram L → ℤ)}
    (hsub : CoordinateSupportIncluded Q S) (P : RuleSetComponents S → Prop)
    (hhit : ∀ C, P C → ∃ v : RuleSetVertex Q,
      supportComponentMap hsub (Quotient.mk (ruleSetSetoid Q) v) = C) :
    Fintype.card {C : RuleSetComponents S // P C} ≤ componentCount Q
proof:
:= by
  apply hit_component_count_le_of_preimages hsub P
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hhit C hC
  exact ⟨Quotient.mk (ruleSetSetoid Q) v, hv⟩

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.TrimmedRun.long_eq
statement:
theorem long_eq (r : TrimmedRun k pre suffix rho bit orientation) :
    pre ++ List.replicate rho bit ++ suffix =
      r.before ++ r.bubble.longWord ++ r.after
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (r.before ++ r.bubble.left) ++ List.replicate rho bit ++
        (r.bubble.right ++ r.after) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun (p s : List Bool) => p ++ List.replicate rho bit ++ s)
        r.pre_eq r.suffix_eq
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [BubbleWord.longWord, r.rho_eq, r.bit_eq, List.append_assoc]

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.TrimmedRun.short_eq
statement:
theorem short_eq (r : TrimmedRun k pre suffix rho bit orientation) :
    pre ++ List.replicate (rho - 1) bit ++ suffix =
      r.before ++ r.bubble.shortWord ++ r.after
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (r.before ++ r.bubble.left) ++ List.replicate (rho - 1) bit ++
        (r.bubble.right ++ r.after) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun (p s : List Bool) => p ++ List.replicate (rho - 1) bit ++ s)
        r.pre_eq r.suffix_eq
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [BubbleWord.shortWord, r.rho_eq, r.bit_eq, List.append_assoc]

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.TrimmedRun.before_length
statement:
theorem before_length (r : TrimmedRun k pre suffix rho bit orientation) :
    r.before.length + (windowLength k - rho) = pre.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg List.length r.pre_eq
  simpa only [List.length_append, r.bubble.left_length, r.rho_eq] using h.symm

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.LocalBubble.start_le
statement:
theorem start_le (p : LocalBubble k source target pos orientation) :
    p.before.length ≤ pos
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.edit_start
  omega

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.LocalBubble.long_end_le
statement:
theorem long_end_le (p : LocalBubble k source target pos orientation) :
    p.before.length + p.bubble.longWord.length ≤ pos + windowLength k
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.edit_start
  have hrho := p.bubble.rho_upper
  rw [p.bubble.left_length] at h
  rw [p.bubble.longWord_length]
  simp only [longLength, BubbleWord.header]
  unfold windowLength at *
  omega

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.LocalBubble.long_interval_bounds
statement:
theorem long_interval_bounds (p : LocalBubble k source target pos orientation) :
    pos + 1 - windowLength k ≤ p.before.length ∧
      p.before.length + p.bubble.longWord.length ≤ pos + windowLength k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := p.edit_stop
    omega
  · exact p.long_end_le

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.interior_flanks
statement:
private theorem interior_flanks (k rho pos : ℕ) (pre suffix : List Bool)
    (hrho : rho ≤ k + 1) (hstart : pre.length ≤ pos)
    (hstop : pos < pre.length + rho)
    (hleft : 4 * windowLength k ≤ pos)
    (hright : pos + 4 * windowLength k ≤ pre.length + rho + suffix.length) :
    windowLength k - rho ≤ pre.length ∧
      windowLength k - rho ≤ suffix.length ∧ 0 < pre.length ∧ 0 < suffix.length
proof:
:= by
  unfold windowLength at *
  omega

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.exists_deletion_bubble
statement:
theorem exists_deletion_bubble (word : List Bool) (pos k : ℕ)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters word) word.length k)
    (hleft : 4 * windowLength k ≤ pos)
    (hright : pos + 4 * windowLength k ≤ word.length) :
    Nonempty (LocalBubble k word (word.eraseIdx pos) pos .deletion)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : pos < word.length := by
    unfold windowLength at hright
    omega
  obtain ⟨pre, suffix, rho, bit, hrho, hrho', hword, hstart, hstop, hpre, hsuffix⟩ :=
    exists_maximal_run_unique word pos k hpos hx
  have hlength := congrArg List.length hword
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at hlength
  have hmargins := interior_flanks k rho pos pre suffix (by omega) hstart hstop
    hleft (by omega)
  have hpreBit : pre.getLast? = some (!bit) := by
    rcases hpre with hempty | hbit
    · subst pre
      simp at hmargins
    · exact hbit
  have hsuffixBit : suffix.head? = some (!bit) := by
    rcases hsuffix with hempty | hbit
    · subst suffix
      simp at hmargins
    · exact hbit
  let r := trimRun k pre suffix rho bit .deletion (by omega) (by omega)
    hmargins.1 hmargins.2.1 hpreBit hsuffixBit
  have hshort : word.eraseIdx pos = pre ++ List.replicate (rho - 1) bit ++ suffix := by
    rw [hword]
    exact eraseIdx_in_run pre suffix rho bit pos hstart hstop
  have hbefore := r.before_length
  have hrhoL : rho ≤ windowLength k := by unfold windowLength; omega
  refine ⟨{
    bubble := r.bubble
    before := r.before
    after := r.after
    orientation_eq := r.orientation_eq
    source_eq := ?_
    target_eq := ?_
    left_boundary := r.left_boundary
    right_boundary := r.right_boundary
    edit_start := ?_
    edit_stop := ?_
  }⟩
  · simpa only [BubbleWord.negativeWord, r.orientation_eq] using hword.trans r.long_eq
  · simpa only [BubbleWord.positiveWord, r.orientation_eq] using hshort.trans r.short_eq
  · rw [r.bubble.left_length, r.rho_eq]
    omega
  · omega

name: DeletionCode.RunBubbleConstruction.exists_insertion_bubble
statement:
theorem exists_insertion_bubble (word : List Bool) (pos k : ℕ) (bit : Bool)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters word) word.length k)
    (hleft : 4 * windowLength k ≤ pos)
    (hright : pos + 4 * windowLength k ≤ word.length) :
    ∃ p : LocalBubble k word (word.take pos ++ bit :: word.drop pos) pos .insertion,
      p.bubble.bit = bit
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : pos ≤ word.length := by omega
  obtain ⟨pre, suffix, rho, hrho, hrho', hlong, hshort, hstart, hstop, hpre, hsuffix⟩ :=
    exists_insertion_run_at_gap_unique word pos bit k hpos hx
  have hlength := congrArg List.length hshort
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at hlength
  have hmargins := interior_flanks k rho pos pre suffix hrho' hstart hstop
    hleft (by omega)
  have hpreBit : pre.getLast? = some (!bit) := by
    rcases hpre with hempty | hbit
    · subst pre
      simp at hmargins
    · exact hbit
  have hsuffixBit : suffix.head? = some (!bit) := by
    rcases hsuffix with hempty | hbit
    · subst suffix
      simp at hmargins
    · exact hbit
  let r := trimRun k pre suffix rho bit .insertion (by omega) hrho'
    hmargins.1 hmargins.2.1 hpreBit hsuffixBit
  have hbefore := r.before_length
  have hrhoL : rho ≤ windowLength k := by unfold windowLength; omega
  refine ⟨{
    bubble := r.bubble
    before := r.before
    after := r.after
    orientation_eq := r.orientation_eq
    source_eq := ?_
    target_eq := ?_
    left_boundary := r.left_boundary
    right_boundary := r.right_boundary
    edit_start := ?_
    edit_stop := ?_
  }, r.bit_eq⟩
  · simpa only [BubbleWord.negativeWord, r.orientation_eq] using hshort.trans r.short_eq
  · simpa only [BubbleWord.positiveWord, r.orientation_eq] using hlong.trans r.long_eq
  · rw [r.bubble.left_length, r.rho_eq]
    omega
  · omega

name: DeletionCode.WitnessCases.relation_block_count
statement:
theorem relation_block_count {t k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (hw : CatalogueRule t k w)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ) (hind : Independent G)
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ)) :
    (selectedBlocks G I).card ≤ 2 * t
proof:
:= by
  apply SupportBlockCount.catalogue_block_count_le G w (selectedBlocks G I) hw
  · intro B hB
    exact ((mem_selectedBlocks G I B).mp hB).1
  · exact relation_support_included G I hIG w a hrel
  · exact selected_block_meets G I hIG w a hind ha hrel

name: DeletionCode.WitnessCases.relation_hull_card
statement:
theorem relation_hull_card {t k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (hw : CatalogueRule t k w)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ) (hind : Independent G)
    (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ))
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks G, B.card ≤ windowLength k) :
    (RelationBlockSavings.blockHull G I).card ≤ 2 * t * windowLength k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← selectedBlocks_biUnion G I hIG]
  calc
    ((selectedBlocks G I).biUnion id).card ≤ ∑ B ∈ selectedBlocks G I, B.card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _B ∈ selectedBlocks G I, windowLength k := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro B hB
      exact hsize B ((mem_selectedBlocks G I B).mp hB).1
    _ = (selectedBlocks G I).card * windowLength k := by simp
    _ ≤ 2 * t * windowLength k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
      (relation_block_count G I hIG w hw a hind ha hrel)

name: DeletionCode.WitnessCases.relation_case
statement:
theorem relation_case {t k : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t)
    (v : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (K : Set (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ))
    (G I : RuleSet k) (hIG : I ⊆ G) (hI : 2 ≤ I.card)
    (hgen : GeneratingAt v G) (hcat : ∀ u ∈ G, CatalogueRule t k u)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ G, u ∈ K) (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks G, B.card ≤ windowLength k)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (hw : CatalogueRule t k w)
    (a : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℚ) (ha : ∀ u ∈ I, a u ≠ 0)
    (hrel : ∀ g, (w g : ℚ) = ∑ u ∈ I, a u * (u g : ℚ)) :
    Witness t k v K (RelationBlockSavings.blockHull G I)
proof:
:= by
  let U := RelationBlockSavings.blockHull G I
  have hUG : U ⊆ G := RelationBlockSavings.blockHull_subset G I
  have hlow : 2 ≤ U.card := hI.trans
    (Finset.card_le_card (RelationBlockSavings.subset_blockHull G I hIG))
  have hupper : U.card ≤ 2 * t * windowLength k :=
    relation_hull_card G I hIG w hw a hgen.independent ha hrel hsize
  have hc : componentCount U ≤ (2 * t - 1) * U.card :=
    RelationBlockSavings.relation_block_hull_bound ht G I hIG hI hcat w hw a ha hrel
  have hL : 1 ≤ windowLength k := by unfold windowLength; omega
  have hquad : 2 * t * windowLength k ≤ 1 + 4 * t * (windowLength k) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * t * windowLength k) hL]
  exact ⟨generating_blockHull hgen I, (fun u hu => hcat u (hUG hu)),
    (fun u hu => hK u (hUG hu)), hlow, hupper.trans hquad, hc.trans (Nat.le_succ _), fun _ => hc⟩

name: DeletionCode.WitnessCases.relation_case_of_span
statement:
theorem relation_case_of_span {t k : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t)
    (v : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (K : Set (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ))
    (G : RuleSet k) (hgen : GeneratingAt v G)
    (hcat : ∀ u ∈ G, CatalogueRule t k u) (hK : ∀ u ∈ G, u ∈ K)
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks G, B.card ≤ windowLength k)
    (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (hw : CatalogueRule t k w)
    (hnew : ∀ u ∈ G, w ≠ u ∧ w ≠ -u)
    (hspan : rational w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (rational '' (↑G : Set _))) :
    ∃ U : RuleSet k, U ⊆ G ∧ Witness t k v K U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hIG, hI, a, ha, hrel⟩ := new_relation_support (by omega : 1 ≤ t)
    G hcat w hw hnew hspan
  exact ⟨_, RelationBlockSavings.blockHull_subset G I,
    relation_case ht v K G I hIG hI hgen hcat hK hsize w hw a ha hrel⟩

name: DeletionCode.WitnessCases.large_block_case
statement:
theorem large_block_case {t k : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t)
    (v : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) (K : Set (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ))
    (G : RuleSet k) (w : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (hgen : GeneratingAt v (insert w G)) (hw : CatalogueRule t k w)
    (hcat : ∀ u ∈ G, CatalogueRule t k u)
    (hK : ∀ u ∈ insert w G, u ∈ K)
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks G, B.card ≤ windowLength k)
    (hbad : ¬ ∀ B ∈ blocks (insert w G), B.card ≤ windowLength k) :
    Witness t k v K (blockOf (insert w G) w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ B ∈ blocks (insert w G), windowLength k < B.card := by
    push Not at hbad
    exact hbad
  have hlarge := LargeBlockSelection.new_block_large_of_exists G w (windowLength k) hsize hex
  have hL : 2 ≤ windowLength k := by unfold windowLength; omega
  have hlow : 2 ≤ (blockOf (insert w G) w).card := hL.trans (Nat.le_of_lt hlarge)
  have hupper := BlockAdjunction.new_block_card_bound G w hw hsize
  have hc := BlockAdjunction.new_block_component_bound (by omega : 1 ≤ t) G w hw hcat
  refine ⟨generating_blockOf hgen w, ?_, ?_, hlow, hupper, hc, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ((mem_blockOf (insert w G) w u).mp hu).1 with huw | huG
    · simpa only [huw] using hw
    · exact hcat u huG
  · intro u hu
    exact hK u ((mem_blockOf (insert w G) w u).mp hu).1
  · intro hsmall
    omega

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.independent_restrict
statement:
theorem independent_restrict {k : ℕ} {G U : RuleSet k} (hUG : U ⊆ G)
    (hind : Independent G) : Independent U
proof:
:= by
  let f : U → G := fun u => ⟨u.val, hUG u.property⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun u : G => u.val) hab)
  exact hind.comp f hf

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.generating_restrict
statement:
theorem generating_restrict {k : ℕ} (v : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ)
    (G U : RuleSet k) (rank : (Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) → ℕ)
    (hUG : U ⊆ G) (hclosed : ClosedIn G U) (hgen : GeneratingOn v G rank) :
    GeneratingOn v U rank
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu g hneg
  rcases hgen u (hUG hu) g hneg with hv | ⟨z, hz, hrank, hzg⟩
  · exact Or.inl hv
  · have hconnect : ConnectedIn G u z := Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _
      ⟨hUG hu, hz, gramPrefix g,
        GeneratingBlocks.nonzero_incident u g (by omega),
        GeneratingBlocks.nonzero_incident z g hzg⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨z, hclosed u hu z hz hconnect, hrank, hzg⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.GeneratingAt.restrict
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rank, hinj, horder⟩ := hgen.ordered
  refine ⟨independent_restrict hUG hgen.independent, rank, ?_,
    generating_restrict v G U rank hUG hclosed horder⟩
  intro a ha b hb hab
  exact hinj (hUG ha) (hUG hb) hab

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.blockHull_closed
statement:
theorem blockHull_closed {k : ℕ} (G I : RuleSet k) :
    ClosedIn G (RelationBlockSavings.blockHull G I)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b _ hab
  exact RelationBlockSavings.blockHull_closed G I ha hab

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.generating_blockHull
proof:
:=
  hgen.restrict (RelationBlockSavings.blockHull_subset G I) (blockHull_closed G I)

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.blockOf_closed
statement:
theorem blockOf_closed {k : ℕ} (G : RuleSet k) (a : Gram (windowLength k) → ℤ) :
    ClosedIn G (blockOf G a)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb c hc hbc
  exact (mem_blockOf G a c).mpr
    ⟨hc, Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _ ((mem_blockOf G a b).mp hb).2 hbc⟩

name: DeletionCode.FiniteGenerating.generating_blockOf
proof:
:= by
  apply hgen.restrict
  · intro u hu
    exact ((mem_blockOf G a u).mp hu).1
  · exact blockOf_closed G a

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.jointHash_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem jointHash_apply (w : J → I → ℤ)
    (weights : I → UnitAddCircle) (j : J) :
    jointHash w weights j = weightedHash weights (w j)
proof: := rfl

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.continuous_jointHash
statement: theorem continuous_jointHash (w : J → I → ℤ) : Continuous (jointHash w)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro j
  change Continuous (fun weights : I → UnitAddCircle => ∑ i, w j i • weights i)
  exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (continuous_apply i).zsmul (w j i))

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.rational_right_inverse
statement:
theorem rational_right_inverse [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix J I ℚ)
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ A.row) :
    ∃ B : Matrix I J ℚ, A * B = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrank : A.rank = Fintype.card J := h.rank_matrix
  have hrange : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    change A.rank = Module.finrank ℚ (J → ℚ)
    simpa only [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] using hrank
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective A.mulVec :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp hrange
  exact Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_exists_right_inverse.mp hsurj

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.real_right_inverse
statement:
theorem real_right_inverse [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix J I ℚ)
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ A.row) :
    ∃ B : Matrix I J ℝ, A.map (Rat.castHom ℝ) * B = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := rational_right_inverse A h
  refine ⟨B.map (Rat.castHom ℝ), ?_⟩
  have hmap := congrArg (fun M : Matrix J J ℚ => M.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) hB
  rw [Matrix.map_mul] at hmap
  have hone : (1 : Matrix J J ℚ).map (Rat.castHom ℝ) = 1 :=
    Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _)
  exact hmap.trans hone

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.realWeightedSums_surjective
statement:
theorem realWeightedSums_surjective (w : J → I → ℤ)
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun j => fun i => (w j i : ℚ))) :
    Function.Surjective (fun weights : I → ℝ =>
      fun j => ∑ i, weights i * (w j i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Matrix J I ℚ := fun j i => (w j i : ℚ)
  have hA : LinearIndependent ℚ A.row := h
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := real_right_inverse A hA
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)).mulVec :=
    Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_exists_right_inverse.mpr ⟨B, hB⟩
  intro target
  obtain ⟨weights, hweights⟩ := hsurj target
  refine ⟨weights, ?_⟩
  funext j
  have hj := congrFun hweights j
  change (∑ i, ((w j i : ℚ) : ℝ) * weights i) = target j at hj
  simpa only [Rat.cast_intCast, mul_comm] using hj

name: DeletionCode.IntegerTorusMap.jointHash_surjective
statement:
theorem jointHash_surjective (w : J → I → ℤ)
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun j => fun i => (w j i : ℚ))) :
    Function.Surjective (jointHash w)
proof:
:= by
  intro target
  obtain ⟨weights, hweights⟩ :=
    realWeightedSums_surjective w h (fun j => representative (target j))
  refine ⟨fun i => (weights i : UnitAddCircle), ?_⟩
  funext j
  have hj : (∑ i, weights i * (w j i : ℝ)) = representative (target j) :=
    congrFun hweights j
  change realWeightedHash weights (w j) = target j
  rw [realWeightedHash_apply, hj, coe_representative]

name: DeletionCode.ScriptRigidity.shared_source_letters
statement:
theorem shared_source_letters {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y z : List Bool)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters x) x.length k)
    (hy : WithinEdits 1 x y) (hz : WithinEdits 1 x z) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : a + (windowLength k - 1) ≤ y.length)
    (hb : b + (windowLength k - 1) ≤ z.length)
    (hag : Agree (listLetters y) a (listLetters z) b (windowLength k - 1)) :
    ∃ e f : Edit, e.Valid x.length ∧ f.Valid x.length ∧
      e.outputLength x.length = y.length ∧ f.outputLength x.length = z.length ∧
      e.word (listLetters x) = listLetters y ∧ f.word (listLetters x) = listLetters z ∧
      ∃ s r : ℕ, s + k ≤ windowLength k - 1 ∧ r + k ≤ x.length ∧
        ∀ i, i < k →
          e.origin (a + s + i) = some (r + i) ∧
          f.origin (b + s + i) = some (r + i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hlen, hword⟩ := SingleEditScripts.within_one_realized hy
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hlen', hword'⟩ := SingleEditScripts.within_one_realized hz
  refine ⟨e, f, he, hf, hlen, hlen', hword, hword', ?_⟩
  apply EditRigidity.shared_source_letters hk (listLetters x) hx e f he hf a b
  · simpa only [hlen] using ha
  · simpa only [hlen'] using hb
  · simpa only [hword, hword'] using hag

name: DeletionCode.ScriptRigidity.within_one_unique
statement:
theorem within_one_unique {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : List Bool)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters x) x.length k) (hy : WithinEdits 1 x y) :
    KUnique (listLetters y) y.length (windowLength k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hlen, hword⟩ := SingleEditScripts.within_one_realized hy
  simpa only [hlen, hword] using EditRigidity.one_edit_unique hk (listLetters x) hx e he

name: DeletionCode.ScriptRigidity.within_one_spectrum_boolean
statement:
theorem within_one_spectrum_boolean {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : List Bool)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters x) x.length k) (hy : WithinEdits 1 x y) :
    ∀ g, SignedSupport.wordSpectrum (listLetters y) y.length (windowLength k) g = 0 ∨
      SignedSupport.wordSpectrum (listLetters y) y.length (windowLength k) g = 1
proof:
:=
  SpectrumPath.spectrum_boolean (listLetters y) y.length (windowLength k)
    (within_one_unique hk x y hx hy)

name: DeletionCode.ScriptRigidity.within_one_vertex_path_injective
statement:
theorem within_one_vertex_path_injective {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (x y : List Bool)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters x) x.length k) (hy : WithinEdits 1 x y)
    (hlen : windowLength k ≤ y.length) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin (y.length - windowLength k + 2) =>
      SpectrumPath.vertexAt (listLetters y) (windowLength k) i.val)
proof:
:=
  SpectrumPath.vertex_path_injective (listLetters y) y.length (windowLength k)
    (by unfold windowLength; omega) hlen (within_one_unique hk x y hx hy)

name: DeletionCode.SingleEditOrigins.Edit.word_of_origin
statement:
theorem word_of_origin (e : Edit) (x : Letters) {i r : ℕ}
    (h : e.origin i = some r) : e.word x i = x r
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | unchanged => exact congrArg x (Option.some.inj h)
  | delete pos =>
    by_cases hi : i < pos
    · have hir : i = r := by simpa only [origin, ite_eq_left hi, Option.some.injEq] using h
      change (if i < pos then x i else x (i + 1)) = x r
      rw [ite_eq_left hi, hir]
    · have hir : i + 1 = r := by simpa only [origin, ite_eq_right hi, Option.some.injEq] using h
      simp only [word, deleteAt, ite_eq_right hi, hir]
  | insert pos bit =>
    by_cases hi : i < pos
    · have hir : i = r := by simpa only [origin, ite_eq_left hi, Option.some.injEq] using h
      change (if i < pos then x i else if i = pos then bit else x (i - 1)) = x r
      rw [ite_eq_left hi, hir]
    · by_cases heq : i = pos
      · simp only [origin, ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_left heq, reduceCtorEq] at h
      · have hir : i - 1 = r := by
          simpa only [origin, ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_right heq, Option.some.injEq] using h
        simp only [word, insertAt, ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_right heq, hir]

name: DeletionCode.SingleEditOrigins.Edit.origin_injective
statement:
theorem origin_injective (e : Edit) {i j r : ℕ}
    (hi : e.origin i = some r) (hj : e.origin j = some r) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | unchanged => exact (Option.some.inj hi).trans (Option.some.inj hj).symm
  | delete pos =>
    by_cases hiCut : i < pos <;> by_cases hjCut : j < pos <;>
      simp only [origin, hiCut, hjCut, ite_true, ite_false, Option.some.injEq] at hi hj <;>
      omega
  | insert pos bit =>
    by_cases hiCut : i < pos <;> by_cases hjCut : j < pos <;>
      by_cases hiEq : i = pos <;> by_cases hjEq : j = pos <;>
      simp_all only [origin, ite_true, ite_false, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq] <;> omega

name: DeletionCode.SingleEditOrigins.Edit.origin_lt
statement:
theorem origin_lt (e : Edit) {n i r : ℕ} (hv : e.Valid n)
    (hi : i < e.outputLength n) (hr : e.origin i = some r) : r < n
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | unchanged =>
    have hir := Option.some.inj hr
    change i < n at hi
    omega
  | delete pos =>
    by_cases hcut : i < pos <;>
      simp only [Valid, outputLength, origin, hcut, ite_true, ite_false,
        Option.some.injEq] at hv hi hr <;> omega
  | insert pos bit =>
    by_cases hcut : i < pos <;> by_cases heq : i = pos <;>
      simp_all only [Valid, outputLength, origin, ite_true, ite_false,
        Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq] <;> omega

name: DeletionCode.SingleEditOrigins.Edit.clean_block
statement:
theorem clean_block (e : Edit) (a s k : ℕ)
    (h : a + s + k ≤ e.cut ∨ e.cut < a + s) :
    ∃ r, ∀ i, i < k → e.origin (a + s + i) = some (r + i)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | unchanged => exact ⟨a + s, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | delete pos =>
    rcases h with hbefore | hafter
    · change a + s + k ≤ pos at hbefore
      refine ⟨a + s, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have hcut : a + s + i < pos := by omega
      simp only [origin, ite_eq_left hcut]
    · change pos < a + s at hafter
      refine ⟨a + s + 1, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have hcut : ¬ a + s + i < pos := by omega
      have heq : a + s + i + 1 = a + s + 1 + i := by omega
      simp only [origin, ite_eq_right hcut, heq]
  | insert pos bit =>
    rcases h with hbefore | hafter
    · change a + s + k ≤ pos at hbefore
      refine ⟨a + s, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have hcut : a + s + i < pos := by omega
      simp only [origin, ite_eq_left hcut]
    · change pos < a + s at hafter
      refine ⟨a + s - 1, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have hcut : ¬ a + s + i < pos := by omega
      have hne : a + s + i ≠ pos := by omega
      have heq : a + s + i - 1 = a + s - 1 + i := by omega
      simp only [origin, ite_eq_right hcut, ite_eq_right hne, heq]

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.exists_large_label_fiber
statement:
theorem exists_large_label_fiber {V : Type*} {Q : ℕ} (I : Finset V)
    (label : V → Fin Q) (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    ∃ a : Fin Q, I.card ≤ Q * (I.filter (fun v => label v = a)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q))
    (fun b => (I.filter (fun v => label v = b)).card) hne
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  calc
    I.card = ∑ b : Fin Q, (I.filter (fun v => label v = b)).card := by
      symm
      simpa only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.filter_true] using
        Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter I (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Q)) label
    _ ≤ ∑ _b : Fin Q, (I.filter (fun v => label v = a)).card :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b hb => ha b hb)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.componentColor_valid
statement:
theorem componentColor_valid (C : G.ConnectedComponent) (hC : C.toSimpleGraph.Colorable 2)
    {v w : C} (hvw : C.toSimpleGraph.Adj v w) :
    componentColor G C v ≠ componentColor G C w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [componentColor, dite_eq_left hC] using hC.some.valid hvw

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.color_eq_component
statement:
theorem color_eq_component (C : G.ConnectedComponent) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ C) :
    color G v = componentColor G C ⟨v, hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  change G.connectedComponentMk v = C at hv
  subst C
  rfl

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.good_color_valid
statement:
theorem good_color_valid {v w : V} (hv : Good G v) (hvw : G.Adj v w) :
    color G v ≠ color G w
proof:
:= by
  let C := G.connectedComponentMk v
  have hvC : v ∈ C := rfl
  have hwC : w ∈ C :=
    (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hvw).symm
  rw [color_eq_component G C v hvC, color_eq_component G C w hwC]
  exact componentColor_valid G C hv (show C.toSimpleGraph.Adj ⟨v, hvC⟩ ⟨w, hwC⟩ from hvw)

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.good_graph_colorable
statement: theorem good_graph_colorable : (G.induce {v | Good G v}).Colorable 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk (fun v => color G v.val) ?_⟩
  intro v w hvw
  exact good_color_valid G v.property hvw

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.mem_goodVertices
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_goodVertices (v : V) : v ∈ goodVertices G ↔ Good G v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [goodVertices, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: DeletionCode.BipartiteSelection.exists_independent_good
statement:
theorem exists_independent_good :
    ∃ I : Finset V, (∀ v ∈ I, Good G v) ∧ G.IsIndepSet (I : Set V) ∧
      (goodVertices G).card ≤ 2 * I.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_large_label_fiber (goodVertices G) (color G) (by decide)
  refine ⟨(goodVertices G).filter (fun v => color G v = a), ?_, ?_, ha⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact (mem_goodVertices G v).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1
  · intro v hv w hw _ hvw
    have hv' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    have hw' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hw
    exact good_color_valid G ((mem_goodVertices G v).mp hv'.1) hvw
      (hv'.2.trans hw'.2.symm)

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.matchedCount_le_length
statement: theorem matchedCount_le_length (trace : Trace) : trace.matchedCount ≤ trace.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace.length_eq_counts
  omega

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.matchedAnchor_le_index
statement: theorem matchedAnchor_le_index (trace : Trace) (i : ℕ) : trace.matchedAnchor i ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := matchedCount_le_length (trace.take i)
  have hlen := List.length_take_le i trace
  exact h.trans hlen

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.matchedAnchor_gap_le
statement:
theorem matchedAnchor_gap_le (trace : Trace) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    trace.matchedAnchor j ≤ trace.matchedAnchor i + (j - i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : trace.take j = trace.take i ++ (trace.drop i).take (j - i) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show j = i + (j - i) by omega, List.take_add]
  have hcount := congrArg Trace.matchedCount hsplit
  rw [Trace.matchedCount_append] at hcount
  have h := matchedCount_le_length ((trace.drop i).take (j - i))
  have hlen := List.length_take_le (j - i) (trace.drop i)
  change Trace.matchedCount (trace.take j) ≤ Trace.matchedCount (trace.take i) + (j - i)
  omega

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.matched_projections
statement:
theorem matched_projections (trace : Trace)
    (hmatched : ∀ col ∈ trace, col.isEdit = false) :
    trace.source = trace.target ∧ trace.source.length = trace.length
proof:
:= by
  induction trace with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons col rest ih =>
    have hcol := hmatched col (List.mem_cons_self)
    have hrest : ∀ c ∈ rest, c.isEdit = false := by
      intro c hc
      exact hmatched c (List.mem_cons_of_mem col hc)
    have h := ih hrest
    cases col with
    | matched bit =>
      simp only [Trace.source, Trace.target, List.length_cons]
      exact ⟨congrArg (List.cons bit) h.1, congrArg (fun n => n + 1) h.2⟩
    | deletion bit => simp only [Column.isEdit, Bool.true_eq_false] at hcol
    | insertion bit => simp only [Column.isEdit, Bool.true_eq_false] at hcol

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.common_suffix_of_matched_range
statement:
theorem common_suffix_of_matched_range (trace : Trace) (i m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ i) (hi : i ≤ trace.length)
    (hno : ∀ j : Fin trace.length, i - m ≤ j.val → j.val < i → ¬ EditIndex trace j) :
    ∃ a b common : List Bool,
      Trace.source (trace.take i) = a ++ common ∧
      Trace.target (trace.take i) = b ++ common ∧ common.length = m
proof:
:= by
  let suffix : Trace := (trace.drop (i - m)).take m
  have hlength : suffix.length = m := by
    simp only [suffix, List.length_take, List.length_drop]
    omega
  have hmatched : ∀ col ∈ suffix, col.isEdit = false := by
    intro col hcol
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hget⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hcol
    have hjm : j < m := by omega
    have hbound : i - m + j < trace.length := by omega
    have hget' : trace.get ⟨i - m + j, hbound⟩ = col := by
      simpa only [suffix, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop] using hget
    have hnot := hno ⟨i - m + j, hbound⟩
      (by change i - m ≤ i - m + j; omega)
      (by change i - m + j < i; omega)
    change ¬ (trace.get ⟨i - m + j, hbound⟩).isEdit = true at hnot
    rw [hget'] at hnot
    cases hbool : col.isEdit <;> simp_all
  obtain ⟨hproj, hprojlen⟩ := matched_projections suffix hmatched
  have hsplit : trace.take i = trace.take (i - m) ++ suffix := by
    dsimp [suffix]
    conv_lhs => rw [show i = (i - m) + m by omega, List.take_add]
  refine ⟨Trace.source (trace.take (i - m)), Trace.target (trace.take (i - m)), suffix.source,
    ?_, ?_, hprojlen.trans hlength⟩
  · rw [hsplit, Trace.source_append]
  · rw [hsplit, Trace.target_append, ← hproj]

name: DeletionCode.TraceMatchedSuffix.common_suffix_before_edit
statement:
theorem common_suffix_before_edit {trace : Trace} {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * L) trace) (i : Fin trace.length) (hi : EditIndex trace i) :
    ∃ a b common : List Bool,
      Trace.source (trace.take i.val) = a ++ common ∧
      Trace.target (trace.take i.val) = b ++ common ∧ L - 1 ≤ common.length
proof:
:= by
  have hanchor := (hsep.1 i hi).1
  have hindex := matchedAnchor_le_index trace i.val
  have hm : L - 1 ≤ i.val := by omega
  have hno : ∀ j : Fin trace.length,
      i.val - (L - 1) ≤ j.val → j.val < i.val → ¬ EditIndex trace j := by
    intro j hjlow hjbefore hj
    have hgap := hsep.2 j i hj hi hjbefore
    have hsmall := matchedAnchor_gap_le trace j.val i.val (Nat.le_of_lt hjbefore)
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, b, common, hs, ht, hlen⟩ := common_suffix_of_matched_range trace i.val (L - 1)
    hm (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt) hno
  exact ⟨a, b, common, hs, ht, by omega⟩

name: DeletionCode.ConcreteModel.Model.window_bound
statement:
theorem Model.window_bound (M : Model B x n k) (b : B) (w : Recovery.Slot) :
    windowStart (negativeExtra k (M.header b)) w + windowLength k ≤
      negativeLength k (M.header b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeLength_eq k (M.header b) (M.rho_lower b) (M.rho_upper b)]
  have := windowStart_le (negativeExtra k (M.header b)) w
  omega

name: DeletionCode.ConcreteModel.Model.complete_known
statement:
theorem Model.complete_known (M : Model B x n k) (s : Recovery.State B)
    (mem : Bank B) (hreal : M.Realizes s mem) (b : B) (hc : s.Complete b) :
    WindowKnown (mem b) 0 (negativeLength k (M.header b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeLength_eq k (M.header b) (M.rho_lower b) (M.rho_upper b)]
  exact hreal.complete_wordKnown s mem (fun b => negativeExtra k (M.header b)) k
    b (Nat.le_of_lt (negativeExtra_lt k (M.header b) (M.rho_lower b) (M.rho_upper b))) hc

name: DeletionCode.ConcreteModel.Model.sound_update
statement:
theorem Model.sound_update [DecidableEq B] (M : Model B x n k)
    (mem : Bank B) (hs : M.Sound mem) (b : B) (t : Memory)
    (ht : PartialWords.Sound t (negativePath k (M.header b) (M.long b))
      (negativeLength k (M.header b))) : M.Sound (Function.update mem b t)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst a
    simpa using ht
  · have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
    simpa [hab, hba] using hs a

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.ruleTest_probability
statement:
theorem ruleTest_probability (k Q : ℕ) (hQ : 2 ≤ Q) (U : RuleSet k)
    (hU : FiniteGenerating.Independent U) :
    realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (ruleTestEvent k Q U) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ U.card
proof:
:= by
  have h := RandomHash.real_simultaneous_test_probability (fun u : U => u.val) hU Q hQ
  simpa only [ruleTestEvent, Subtype.forall, Fintype.card_coe] using h

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.candidateEvent_eq_union
statement:
theorem candidateEvent_eq_union (t k Q R : ℕ) (x : Bits n) :
    candidateEvent t k Q R x =
      ⋃ U : {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U}, ruleTestEvent k Q U.val
proof:
:= by
  ext weights
  change (∃ U : RuleSet k, Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U ∧
    weights ∈ ruleTestEvent k Q U) ↔ _
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, htest⟩
    exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, htest⟩
  · rintro ⟨U, htest⟩
    exact ⟨U.val, U.property, htest⟩

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.candidate_probability_le
statement:
theorem candidate_probability_le (t k Q R : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (x : Bits n) (hx : KUnique (padBits x) n k) (hQ : 2 ≤ Q) :
    realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (candidateEvent t k Q R x) ≤
      (Nat.card {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U} : ℝ≥0∞) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := candidate_finite t ht (padBits x) n k R hR hx
  let : Fintype {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [candidateEvent_eq_union]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ U : {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U},
        realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (ruleTestEvent k Q U.val) :=
      measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ = ∑ _U : {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U},
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro U _hU
      rw [ruleTest_probability k Q hQ U.val U.property.independent, U.property.generating.1]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.obstructionEvent_subset_union
statement:
theorem obstructionEvent_subset_union (t k Q : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hQ : 2 ≤ Q)
    (x : Bits n) :
    obstructionEvent t k Q x ⊆
      ⋃ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k), candidateEvent t k Q R x
proof:
:= by
  intro weights hbad
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hnot⟩ := hbad
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hgen⟩ :=
    VerifiedConflictGraphWitness.bounded_witness ht hQ (realWeightedHash weights) v hnot
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨U.card, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hU.bounds.size_lower, hU.bounds.size_upper⟩
  · refine ⟨U, ⟨?_, hU.bounds, hU.generating.independent⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hv] using hgen
    · intro u hu
      exact (hU.surviving u hu).2

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.obstruction_probability_le_of_unique
statement:
theorem obstruction_probability_le_of_unique (t k Q : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hQ : 2 ≤ Q)
    (x : Bits n) (hx : KUnique (padBits x) n k) :
    realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (obstructionEvent t k Q x) ≤
      ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k),
        (Nat.card {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U} : ℝ≥0∞) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ realWeights (Gram (windowLength k))
        (⋃ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k), candidateEvent t k Q R x) :=
      measure_mono (obstructionEvent_subset_union t k Q ht hQ x)
    _ ≤ ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k),
        realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (candidateEvent t k Q R x) :=
      measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro R hR
      exact candidate_probability_le t k Q R (by omega)
        (by have h := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hR).1; omega) x hx hQ

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.obstructionEvent_empty_of_not_unique
statement:
theorem obstructionEvent_empty_of_not_unique (t k Q : ℕ) (x : Bits n)
    (hx : ¬ KUnique (padBits x) n k) : obstructionEvent t k Q x = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext weights
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _hnot⟩ := h
    apply hx
    simpa only [hv] using FiniteConflictGraph.vertex_unique v
  · intro h
    exact h.elim

name: DeletionCode.ObstructionProbability.obstruction_probability_le
statement:
theorem obstruction_probability_le (t k Q : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hQ : 2 ≤ Q)
    (x : Bits n) :
    realWeights (Gram (windowLength k)) (obstructionEvent t k Q x) ≤
      ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (cutoff t k),
        (Nat.card {U : RuleSet k // Candidate t (padBits x) n k R U} : ℝ≥0∞) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (Q : ℝ)) ^ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : KUnique (padBits x) n k
  · exact obstruction_probability_le_of_unique t k Q ht hQ x hx
  · rw [obstructionEvent_empty_of_not_unique t k Q x hx, measure_empty]
    exact bot_le

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.position_margins
statement:
theorem position_margins (trace : Trace) (k : ℕ)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * windowLength k) trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    4 * windowLength k ≤ position trace c ∧
      position trace c + 4 * windowLength k ≤ trace.source.length
proof:
:=
  TraceSeparation.sourcePosition_margins hsep c.val c.property

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.exists_bubbleAt
statement:
theorem exists_bubbleAt (trace : Trace) (k : ℕ)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters trace.source) trace.source.length k)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * windowLength k) trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    Nonempty (BubbleAt trace k c)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := position_margins trace k hsep c
  rcases column_cases trace c with ⟨b, hc⟩ | ⟨b, hc⟩
  · unfold BubbleAt
    rw [orientation_of_deletion trace c b hc, oneEditTarget_of_deletion trace c b hc]
    exact exists_deletion_bubble trace.source (position trace c) k hx hm.1 hm.2
  · unfold BubbleAt
    rw [orientation_of_insertion trace c b hc, oneEditTarget_of_insertion trace c b hc]
    obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := exists_insertion_bubble trace.source (position trace c) k b hx hm.1 hm.2
    exact ⟨p⟩

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.bubbleAt_orientation
statement:
theorem bubbleAt_orientation (trace : Trace) (k : ℕ)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters trace.source) trace.source.length k)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * windowLength k) trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).bubble.orientation = orientation trace c
proof:
:=
  (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).orientation_eq

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.bubbleAt_source
statement:
theorem bubbleAt_source (trace : Trace) (k : ℕ)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters trace.source) trace.source.length k)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * windowLength k) trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    trace.source = (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).before ++
      (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).bubble.negativeWord ++ (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).after
proof:
:=
  (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).source_eq

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.bubbleAt_target
statement:
theorem bubbleAt_target (trace : Trace) (k : ℕ)
    (hx : KUnique (listLetters trace.source) trace.source.length k)
    (hsep : Separated (4 * windowLength k) trace) (c : EditColumn trace) :
    oneEditTarget trace c = (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).before ++
      (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).bubble.positiveWord ++ (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).after
proof:
:=
  (bubbleAt trace k hx hsep c).target_eq

name: DeletionCode.TraceBubbleFamily.indexedBubbleWords_orientation
statement:
theorem indexedBubbleWords_orientation (trace : Trace) (k t : ℕ)
